title: If the saved density can't load, Regular is used
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}, with no lead technician.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Load Fail and {Work-order-1} is S1-702.
  • A developer can make your saved density fail to load. This cannot be done from the product; without it, step 3 cannot be checked by hand.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  2. Reload the page.
  3. Ask the developer to make your saved density fail to load, then reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Comfortable" is in use and the rows are roomier.
  • Step 2: Tech View opens again with "Comfortable" still in use (the saved density loads normally).
  • Step 3: Tech View uses "Regular": the rows have the normal spacing, not the roomy spacing of step 2. If no developer could make the load fail, write "load failure not checked by hand" for this step.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10049 (Story 6, Density in Tech View and Board View)

  • S6-N2: “If saved density cannot be loaded, use Regular.”
  • S6-R7: “Save density per user across sessions, logout/login, devices, and locations.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

AUTOMATION: READY
